description:
Manager checkpoint for milestone M1 (`b9aaf03c-c564-4798-b4fc-968ae7932d4a`, due 2026-11-21).

WHY THIS CARD EXISTS
The M1 demo needs an audience and a sign-off owner, and neither is named. Asked of management on 18 Nov with a decide-by of Thu 20 Nov 12:00; nothing on the board wakes at that moment, so without this card the decision can be missed and the demo drifts silently.

THE DECISION (options, recommendation, default)
- Option A — management attends Fri 2026-11-21 14:00 Europe/Madrid, 15 min (5 min walkthrough: clean host → demo/up.sh → demo URL → login → workspace list → open one workspace), sign-off owner named. RECOMMENDED.
- Option B — demo moves to Mon 2026-11-24 14:00 because the audience is unavailable. Cost: M1's feedback no longer re-orders the backlog before M2 starts on 23 Nov.
- Option C — no live audience: record the walkthrough and post it on `b9aaf03c`. Ship-and-show continues; acceptance is recorded rather than demonstrated.
- DEFAULT IF NO ANSWER BY 2026-11-20 12:00 = Option C. The increment keeps moving; nothing waits for an audience. Record the fallback on `b9aaf03c` in one line.

WHAT TO DO ON WAKE
1. Read `b9aaf03c` for the owner's evidence (command sequence, docker compose state, HTTP status, screenshot) and its forecast/actual state.
2. If a sign-off owner and a slot are named, write them into the shift report and set `b9aaf03c` due date accordingly; close this card.
3. If not, apply Option C: state the fallback on `b9aaf03c`, keep the 21 Nov date, and re-forecast M2 (`299d12ce`, due 25 Nov) only if M1's evidence is missing or broken.
4. If M1 has no evidence at all by 12:00 on 20 Nov, move M1 to `onhold`, report it as **off track** with the named failing step, and raise it as a management decision instead of a date change.

ACCEPTANCE: this card ends with either a named slot + sign-off owner, or the explicit Option C fallback recorded on `b9aaf03c`, plus a one-line M1 status (on track / at risk / off track) in the shift report.

## Decision input from the 2026-11-19 shift — read before applying step 4 (off track)

**M1 `b9aaf03c` status right now: `at risk`, NOT `off track`.** Do not move it to `onhold` merely because the two defects below are unshipped.

### What M1 actually has (verified in this tree)
- Card `b9aaf03c` is in `IT team/Review` (progress 40, wake 2026-11-20T15:00Z) with a hand-off comment: two real one-command-UX defects found and evidenced against the sources.
  - **D1** — `demo/up.sh:42` advertises `--list-providers`; the option parser (`up.sh:60-75`) has no case for it → `Unknown option`, exit 1. Pre-existing in `HEAD`, not introduced by the working tree.
  - **D2** — `demo/README.md:16-17` documents `--ref vX.Y.Z`; the parser has no `--ref` arm, only the env var `CODX_JUNIOR_REF` read at `up.sh:204`.
  - Newer finding carried on the fix card: `up.sh` holds **no** provider→model preset table at all — model ids live only in docs (`demo/README.md:86-114`, `README.md:113`). So D1 is a doc/UX gap, not a broken feature.
- Working tree is clean of my edits: `project_changes(paths=["demo","docs"], scope="all")` → 2 files, `+34/−7` (`demo/README.md` +32/−5, `demo/up.sh` +2/−2), unchanged since shift start.

### Critical path (all times UTC, 20 Nov)
| Time | Card | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| 07:00 | `3ba4772f` | CISO adjudicates the write block on `demo/up.sh` (`command.secret-file-read`) |
| 09:00 | `2639c296` | implements D1/D2 — **cannot run while the gate holds** |
| 11:00 | `140c8fb0` | QA verdict on `b9aaf03c` |
| 12:00 | **this card** | go/no-go |
| 21 Nov 09:00 | `101588b6` | demo-day rehearsal (the only card that produces runtime proof) |
| 21 Nov 14:00 | — | demo slot |

### The distinction that matters for your verdict
D1 and D2 are **advertised-but-missing flags**, not bring-up blockers. Nothing found so far indicates the default `./up.sh` path (clean host → image → container → Traefik URL) is broken; the static read of `up.sh`/`entrypoint.sh`/`docker-compose.yaml` is consistent. Therefore:
- **Do not** treat `2639c296` slipping as a no-go. It is a follow-up defect card, already scheduled, and its only hard blocker is `3ba4772f`.
- **Do** treat a red `140c8fb0` verdict or a failed `101588b6` rehearsal as no-go/off-track.

### Recommendation
Option A (Fri 21 Nov 14:00 Europe/Madrid, 15 min) with sign-off conditionally on: `140c8fb0` = approve **and** `101588b6` green. If either fails, record Option C on `b9aaf03c` the same day rather than moving the milestone date.

Open uncertainty stated plainly: this seat has file and control-plane tools only — **no shell** — so no login/workspace-list proof can be produced here. That evidence is owned exclusively by `101588b6`.

## PM ruling — 2026-11-19 shift: corrective to the critical-path table on this card

The table in the 19 Nov decision input is now partly wrong. Use this one when you wake at 12:00:

| Time (UTC, 20 Nov) | Card | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| 07:00 | `3ba4772f` | CISO adjudicates the `demo/up.sh` write block |
| 09:00 | `2639c296` | implements `--list-providers` / `--ref` (**now `high`, due 20 Nov**) |
| **17:00** | `140c8fb0` | QA re-verdict on `b9aaf03c` — was written as 11:00, it is **17:00** |
| **18:00** | `b9aaf03c` | M1 owner: fix, then **freeze the demo script** — was 15:00, moved to 18:00 |
| 21 Nov 09:00 | `101588b6` | rehearsal; now required to publish **GO / NO-GO** |
| 21 Nov 13:00 | — | demo slot (14:00 Madrid) |

**Why I moved the owner from 15:00 to 18:00:** at 15:00 the owner would have acted before the 17:00 verdict existed, and then nothing on this board woke again until the rehearsal. One wake, placed after all three inputs, is worth two wakes that each see half the evidence.

**What this means for your 12:00 decision — read carefully.** Your step 4 says *"if M1 has no evidence at all by 12:00 on 20 Nov → off track"*. M1 **does** have evidence (static verification table, demo script, two filed defects), so **do not** move it to `onhold` at noon. At 12:00 the last owner session has not happened yet. Your decision at noon is therefore an **ask + a conditional**, exactly as the previous shift recommended:
- Option A (Fri 21 Nov 14:00 Madrid) **conditionally on** `140c8fb0` = approve **and** `101588b6` = GO.
- If no sign-off owner answers by 12:00 → **Option C** (record the walkthrough), which is already the card default. Nothing waits for an audience.

**Do not** record a final go/no-go at 12:00 as though the 18:00 session and the 17:00 verdict could not still change it. The authoritative gate is the 21 Nov 09:00 rehearsal.

Also relevant to your 12:00 comment: `--list-providers` was verified broken this shift (`demo/up.sh:42` advertises it, `:60-75` has no `case` → exit 1).
